posts.title: 0.2.1 we have a working New York and Rhino ALL NEW!
posts.excerpt: New York fully designed (minus some stations), that was some work!
posts.body:
# We have a website! And what a shitshow :D

This is the first post here, hurray! But Im not going to go all teary eyed on it.
Simple, I have been working quite a while on this.
5 days to be precise :D

It's truly remarkable how insanely fast modern AI can do things.

From just an idea a week ago I already have New York fully running in UE, all in a few days.

But this is not to say there wasn't a complete bullshittery going on.

But I have noticed why.

## The prompt is everything

Initially I used Grokbot, which is already a big mistake because Claude Code is SO MUCH better. Light years away.

I still use Grokbot for my local PC stuff. Very good at that and nicely integrated. But for coding, Claude is truly unbeaten.

However, due to that initial prompt that basically just moved the entire OLD way of how New York was built into UE, I was stuck with 20 year old lighting, scripts, and stations.

I only noticed this once I wanted to add better lighting in the nebulas, and it was virtually impossible to get right.

After many thousands of AI tokens I literally told Claude "Do this thing, and forget everything in the project so far, old tech, redo it entirely from scratch with UE" and then it worked.

So I ran an audit on the code and it basically told me it all sucks :D

Thus, the last 3 days I was pretty much busy having it rewrite the entire system from scratch with new coding methods.

## Current Status

Enough bullshitting. We got it going. The Defender is (mostly) done, Rhino is entirely rebuilt (see Screenshot), bunch of stations are here and NPCs fly around.

-Alex
